mcp.intro: MCP is the standard that lets AI agents (Claude, Cursor, your own programs) work with external services. An agent with a token can search and read your mail and attachments (only those checked by the antivirus), view contacts and the calendar, and prepare drafts. It can change and send messages only if you allow it. Everything the agent does is logged.
